newsitem.title: ITALY: ENI to give max price of share offer Oct 20.
newsitem.headline: ENI to give max price of share offer Oct 20.

text.p: State energy group ENI will announce the maximum price and detail the price formula which it will apply in a second offering of shares on October 20, according to a preliminary timetable obtained by Reuters.
The share offer will close on October 25. A retail roadshow is planned, starting on October 7, and the maximum price is to be set on October 19 and published the following day.
ENI was floated on the stock exchange in December after an initial public offering of 15 percent of its stock.
Treasury Director General Mario Draghi said that further details of the offering would be announced next week after stock market regulator Consob approves the offer prospectus.
Among details to be made available are the amount of shares the treasury intends to sell.
Draghi ruled out adopting a partly-paid formula because the appropriate regulations are not in place yet.
